outcome: natural course of RLV during pregnancy and postpartum
finding: Temporary RLV-induced dilation of the deep inguinal ring in pregnancy was not found to be a common precursor for the development of inguinal hernias later in life.
mod_finding: This study found that round ligament varicosity (RLV) in pregnancy did not increase the risk of developing inguinal hernias later in life, and is not an indication for cesarean section.
